risk360/reports/download-report.operation_summary: Downloads a generated report file as an attachment. First, generate the report with the risk_generate_report GraphQL query, and then check its progress with risk_report_status. When the job completes, use the report_id, report_type, and file_name values it returns. To download an earlier report, get these values from risk_historical_reports. For multi-tenant API clients, include the x-zinsights-scope header (for example, RISK360:<cloud>:<tenant_id>) to select the tenant.

query_params.name: file_name
query_params.description: Optional. The file name to use for the downloaded attachment.

query_params.name: report_id
query_params.description: The unique identifier of the generated report.

query_params.name: report_type
query_params.description: The type of the generated report (for example, eas_reporting).

query_params.name: source
query_params.description: The product that generated the report. Only risk is currently supported.
